preview.title: One crest. Your whole wedding.
preview.intro: See your selected design on wedding stationery. Switch designs above to compare.

preview.welcome_body: We are so happy you are here to celebrate with us.
preview.thanks_body: Thank you for being part of our celebration.
preview.image_alt: Selected wedding crest in a stationery preview
preview.disclaimer: Includes three stationery preview images: invitation, welcome sign and thank-you card. These are mockups, not editable templates or printed products.
preview.delivery_files: Your selected original crest, completed AI variations, PNG / JPEG / WebP exports, transparent PNG / WebP, and three stationery previews, without watermarks.

preview.dimensions_pending: Image dimensions will appear when the preview loads.
preview.original_note: Original artwork is preserved. Transparent files remove only light background connected to the image edges; inspect fine details before print. JPEG uses a white background. No vector or editable text is included.
preview.how_body: Download your image pack → Place your crest in a Canva design or share it with your designer → Confirm layout and print settings with your printer.
preview.print_note: Mockups do not certify large-format print quality. Ask your printer to check the source image at your intended size.
preview.image_error: The preview image could not be loaded. Please reload your design.
